description: Buy fuel at your current docked station. Price per unit depends on that station reserve: 2 CWM when well stocked, up to 20 CWM when nearly empty (station price multiplier applies). Omit units to fill tank completely.

bearer.description: Your SPACE-CORE Bearer token. Only needed if your client cannot send the Authorization header.

units.description: Fuel units to buy (integer >= 1; optional — fills the tank completely if omitted)

name: refuel
title: Refuel ship
